runtime_boundary: No new runtime in this audit. Candidate execution evidence is the pinned 1.5.59 arm64 October 29/30 capture; current latest release/master are refreshed.

candidates.observation: RENEWLEASE with not-a-token returns a non-NULL new lease token and expiration.
candidates.source_contract: Current docs say unparseable and expired tokens return no row; recorded Omni rejects with InvalidArgument, so do not demand one exact error code.
candidates.implementation: Only NULL/empty input is rejected; any other string is returned with -renewed appended. Mock naming means this may be triaged as missing lease semantics rather than an accidental regression.
candidates.further_scope_unverified: Actual expiration renewal, acknowledged/expired token behavior and redelivery state require isolated runtime checks.

candidates.observation: RECEIVE executes under ExactStaleness instead of rejecting the non-strong read.
candidates.source_contract: Official queues-using requires strong reads; recorded Omni rejects with Queue receive queries must use strong concurrency.

candidates.kind: feature-parity request, not an executed wrong-result bug
candidates.observation: INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_OPTIONS is not found on Emulator; recorded Omni queries execute.
candidates.relationship: ROUTINES-family metadata is already reported; TABLE_OPTIONS itself has no exact keyword report.

deferred.disposition: Needs an isolated timing reproducer. Existing long receive attempts time out; some short probes run nested lease controls before emitting elapsed time, so elapsed_ms alone is not clean first-row latency.
Needs a narrow validator/flag/contract check before a new issue; known hint and index limitations must be separated from physical index use, which Emulator does not expose in plans.
Feature requests for rejected capabilities, not newly established incorrect-result bugs; HLL_COUNT has no keyword match, while generic corresponding searches include unrelated matches.
Existing matching symptom in #186 comments; prefer follow-up or narrowly establish a different case.
#238 concerns jsonb_set/jsonb_concat; it is related rather than proof that every unsupported comparison is the same bug.
Already reported in #395; current 1.5.59 reproduction is additional evidence, not a new issue.
Generated protobuf timestamp #332, FK metadata #353 and Change Streams #210/#280/#352 already have reports.
Expected multiplexed-session enumeration contract is not settled by the retained observations; do not call missing enumeration a confirmed new bug.

duplicate_audit_limit: No identical report found in accessible issue bodies and targeted indexed comments. This is not exhaustive proof about private trackers, discussions, every unindexed comment, or all PR diffs.
